messages:
maya: heads-up: saw a customer (RB-4827) get billed twice for the same user request when the runtime retried from a streaming path to a sync/toolcall path
aleks: ugh. which model/runtime? any repro steps?
maya: repro attached in ticket. runtime emitted stream chunks (prefix) then retried due to transient grpc error and replayed as a toolcall completion -> both events show up in console billing
sam: do we currently dedupe across different billing event types (stream_chunk vs completion)?
maya: nope. stream_chunk events are keyed differently from completion events, so ingest treats them as separate line items
ravi: are we preserving a shared idempotency/dedupe key when we switch paths? i thought retries carried request-id through
maya: streaming path doesn't set the same idempotency header on incremental emissions. On fallback we re-issue as a fresh toolcall with a new envelope, so billing sees two unrelated attempts
aleks: can you paste sample logs?
maya: paste from repro:
```
[2026-06-03T09:12:01Z] req=rb4827 attempt=1 path=stream emitted_tokens=120 billed=stream_chunk
[2026-06-03T09:12:03Z] req=rb4827 attempt=2 path=toolcall emitted_tokens=510 billed=completion
```
maya: result: customer billed for ~630 tokens instead of ~510 (prefix double-counted)
sam: why does toolcall include the prefix again? shouldn't cached prefix be elided on the materialized prompt?
maya: cached prefix is materialized into the toolcall request for safety, so yes the prefix appears in both recorded emissions
ravi: mitigation idea: when runtime falls back from stream->toolcall, copy a dedupe header like x-idempotency-dedupe=req-id and set attempt>1, then billing-ingest can coalesce events that share that header
aleks: ingest-side: coalesce stream_chunk + completion by dedupe key if attempt>1 and retry_reason in {grpc-retry, internal-error}. Also ensure we subtract already_billed_prefix_tokens to avoid double reporting
sam: caution: do not coalesce when user legitimately closed the stream and that partial chunk should be billed separately. We only want to merge server-side retry cases
maya: agree. rule: coalesce only if server-initiated retry (server_retry=true) and attempt>1
aleks: small hotfix: when fallback occurs, emit header carry_prefix_tokens=true so billing can be explicit about overlap handling. ingest maps that to coalesce logic
maya: added to RB-4827: runtime patch + ingest change + unit tests for cached-prefix overlap
ravi: another edge: toolcall path sometimes triggers prompt truncation that reduces final token count below the already-billed stream prefix, leaving a negative reconcile delta
sam: negative deltas are bad UX. reconciler should clamp to zero and mark anomaly, not show customers negative credits
maya: noted. we'll add monotonicity checks in reconciliation and an alert for any negative adjustments
billing-bot: Incident RB-4827 created severity=P2 owners=maya,aleks,sam assignee=maya
maya: console UX: show coalesced billing line as primary, allow expand to show underlying stream_chunk + completion events. avoids confusion while retaining transparency
aleks: dashboard request: add a new "dedupe merges" metric for the last 30 days so SRE/finance can monitor frequency and spikes
ravi: plus an alert if coalesce_rate > 0.5% of billable requests in a region (indicates regression)
sam: i'll review runtime PR and add logs that print dedupe header and original attempt count in debug mode
maya: adding reproduction harness and minimal script to the ticket, will ping finance-ops for customer comms template
finance-ops: noted, will prepare a short explanation and offer to reconcile affected invoices if needed
maya: thanks all — i'll push the runtime PR today and follow with billing-ingest changes. will post links here when up
sam: :thumbsup:
maya: end
